A '''star system''' with an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] was the site of a brief [[Second skirmish in the Outer Rim|skirmish]] between [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] forces of [[Urias Xhaxin]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25.2 ABY]].
